reviewer: Independent Codex vision review (motion/character creative reskin)
scope: Separate qualitative style assessment; does not override fixed visual/delivery rubric.
shapePolicy: Refine primitive character shapes while keeping nominal scale, pose, facing and supports.
observation: Finished hair clumps, face, tailored cloth, natural hands and cuffed boots replace crude cap/capsule/box forms. This strongly realizes the visual redesign, but the enlarged body and shifted support fail registration.
